svg.title: Daily workload across the 24-day plan
svg.desc: Day-by-day view of the study plan: question-bank drills per day (peaks of 50 and 44 in Phase 3), full practice tests, 1600.io book chapters, Problem Sette sets, OnePrep Preppy Taker practices and the number of questions reviewed in the vault.
svg.text: What the 24 days actually looked like
Every planned item that was ticked off in Study Plan.md, day by day
Drills = College Board question-bank questions. From Day 16 on, each day's count was set by how many college classes Felipe had.
Columns are plan days, not calendar days: the last week ran about two days behind and was compressed
(BT11 was planned for Mar 11 and taken Mar 12). Chips: blue = Bluebook, orange = OnePrep, green = official SAT.
